title: The Chicken Is a Living Gimbal
brief: A biology-and-engineering explainer triggered by the supplied chicken-versus-stabilizer signal, but developed as a mechanism story rather than a comparison video. When a chicken’s body moves, its head can remain visually stable through coordinated neck motion, visual feedback and vestibulo-ocular reflexes. Visuals can isolate body motion, head motion and retinal image stability, then compare the biological control loop with a mechanical camera gimbal. Consequence: the same principles inform animal vision research, robotics and stabilization systems.

topic_candidates.title: The Computer That Boils Its Own Cooling Liquid
topic_candidates.query: Microsoft Research two phase immersion cooling server boiling liquid overclocking
topic_candidates.brief: A premium technology explainer about servers immersed in nonconductive fluid. The mechanism is counterintuitive: hot chips boil a low-boiling-point dielectric liquid, vapor rises to condenser coils, then the liquid rains back down. Visual explanation can contrast air cooling, water cooling and phase-change cooling while showing why dense AI hardware is pushing datacenters toward radically different thermal designs. Consequence: higher power density and potential performance gains, balanced against fluid chemistry, lifecycle and regulatory tradeoffs.
topic_candidates.evidence_summary: Demand: High, supported by the supplied liquid-PC, GPU-cost and AI/hardware signals. Visual potential: exceptional—transparent tank cutaway, boiling bubbles, heat maps and rack-density comparisons. Evidence strength: very high; Microsoft Research documents prototype tanks, overclocking results and system-level tradeoffs. Broad curiosity: high. Novelty: high, although the broad idea of liquid-cooled computers is already familiar, so the story should focus on phase change and datacenter scale rather than a desktop stunt.

topic_candidates.brief: An evidence-backed sensing explainer about reconstructing movement from radio reflections rather than visible light. Consequence: contactless monitoring and search applications become possible, while accuracy, privacy and environmental limitations provide necessary tension.
